paragraphs: R' Natan ben Avtolmas. See the entry R' Yonatan.[^1]

notes.text: Avtolmas transliterates אבטולמס with conventional vowels. The earlier suggestion of a connection to Ptolemy is not Hyman’s assertion and is not adopted here. Both abbreviated titles remain R'; Natan and Yonatan are preserved as distinct supplied forms.
